formalDefinition: MinSTCut = {<G,s,t> | G is a weighted directed graph with source s and sink t} — find the partition of V into S (containing s) and T (containing t) minimizing the total capacity of edges directed from S to T.
problemDefinition: Given a weighted directed graph with non-negative edge capacities, a source node s, and a sink node t, find a partition of the vertices into S (containing s) and T (containing t) such that the total capacity of edges directed from S to T is minimized. By the Max-Flow Min-Cut theorem, this minimum cut capacity equals the maximum flow from s to t.
inputDescription: A weighted directed graph with a source vertex and a sink vertex
outputDescription: The set of vertices on the source side of a minimum s-t cut
source: Ford, L. R.; Fulkerson, D. R. (1956). Maximal flow through a network. Canadian Journal of Mathematics, 8, 399–404.
instanceFormat: Weighted directed graph with source and sink: ({nodes},{((u,v),w),...},source,target) — e.g. ({1,2,3,4},{((1,2),10),((1,3),2),((2,4),3),((3,4),5)},1,4)
certificateFormat: Set of vertices on the S side of the minimum cut (must contain source, must not contain target): {node,...} — e.g. {1,2}

defaultSolver.solverDefinition: Uses the Edmonds-Karp algorithm (BFS-based Ford-Fulkerson max-flow) to find the maximum s-t flow, then identifies the minimum cut S side via BFS on the residual graph from the source. Certificate format: {node1,node2,...} representing the S side of the minimum cut.

defaultVerifier.verifierDefinition: Verifies that the certificate represents a valid S side of a minimum S-T cut: source is in S, target is not in S, all nodes exist, no duplicates, and the cut capacity equals the true minimum cut capacity computed by Edmonds-Karp.

defaultVisualization.visualizationDefinition: Displays a weighted directed graph and highlights the minimum S-T cut: S-side nodes are colored and cut edges (directed from S to T) are colored and dashed.

solver.solverDefinition: Uses the Edmonds-Karp algorithm (BFS-based Ford-Fulkerson max-flow) to find the maximum s-t flow, then identifies the minimum cut S side via BFS on the residual graph from the source. Certificate format: {node1,node2,...} representing the S side of the minimum cut.
